chapter.verse: Hih thute a gen khit ciangin Jesu in vantung lam dakto-in hih bangin ci hi: “Pa aw, hunlenai tung ta hi. Tapa in nang' min hong sangkhan theih nadingin na Tapa' min hong sangkhan in.
Mi khempeuh' tungah thu a nei dingin uktheihna thu amah na guan khinzo a, tua pen ama' tunga na piaksa mi khempeuh' tungah tawntung nuntakna a piak theih nading ahi hi.
Khat bek a om Pasian taktak ahi nangmah hong theihna uh leh nangma' sawl Jesu Khris hong theihna uh pen tawntung nuntakna ahi hi.
Sep dinga nong ap nasep zawhsiangna tawh leitung ah na min kong sangkhan khin hi.
Tua ahih manin Pa aw, leitung pian ma-a nangma' kianga ka neih minpha mah tawh tu-in nangma' ompihna sungah ka min hong sangkhan ta in.
“Leitung mite lakpan kei nong ap mite' tungah nangma' min ka lakkhia khinzo hi. Amau pen nangma' mi hi-in kei' tunga nong ap hi a, amaute in na thu hong zui uh hi.
Tu-in kei nong apte a vekin nangma' kiangpan ahihlam amaute in thei uh hi.
A hang pen kei nong guatsa thute amau ka guan a, amau zong tua thute sang uh hi. Nangma' kiangpan a kuankhia ka hihlam maantak hong thei ta uh a, nangma' sawl ka hihlam hong um ta uh hi.
Amaute' ading thu kong ngen hi. Leitung mite' ading hong ngen ka hikei a, kei nong apsate nangma' a ahih manin tua mite' ading hong ngen ka hi hi.
Keima' ate a vekun nangma' a hi a, nangma' ate zong a vekun keima' a ahi hi. Tua hi a, amaute' hangin minpha ka ngah hi.

Kei pen nangma' kiangah hong pai ta ding ka hih manin leitung ah ka om nawnkei a, amau ahihleh leitung ah om uh hi. Siangtho Pa aw, nang leh kei pumkhat i hih mah bangin kei nong apsa mite zong pumkhat ahi dingin nangma' min tawh kembit ta in.

Amau tawh ka omkhop lai-in kei' tunga nong guat na min tawh amaute ka kem hi. Amaute ka cing a, kisiatna tapa khat lobuang a si a mang khat zong om lo uh hi. Tua zong Pasian' Laibu a tangtun nading ahi hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in nang' kiang hong pai ta ding ka hih manin amaute a sung uhah keima' nuamna tawh a kidim theih nadingun leitung ah hih thute a gen ka hi hi.
Amaute' tungah nangma' thu ka guan khin a, leitung tawh kisawh lo ka hih mah bangin amaute zong leitung tawh kisawh lo uh ahih manin leitung in amaute mudah hi.
Amaute leitung pan lakkhiat ding thu hong ngen ka hikei a, Gilo' kiangpan amaute na hut nading hong ngen ka hi hi.
Kei pen leitung tawh kisawh lo ka hih mah bangin amau zong leitung tawh kisawh lo uh hi.
Thumaan thutak tawh amaute siansuah in; na thu pen thumaan thutak ahi hi.
Leitung ah kei nong sawlkhiat mah bangin kei zong leitung mah ah amaute ka sawlkhia hi.
Thumaan thutak tawh amaute a kisiansuah theih nadingin amau ka khualna-in keimahmah ka kisiansuah hi.
“Hih teng' ading bek hilo-in amau' thugenna hanga kei hong um ding mite' adingin zong thu hong ngen ka hi hi.
Pa aw, kei' sungah nang omin nang' sungah kei ka omdan lianin amaute a vekun pumkhat hisak inla, kei nong sawl lam leitung in a up theih nadingin amaute zong eimau' sungah omsak in.
Nang leh kei pumkhat i hihdan lianin amau zong pumkhat ahih theih nadingun kei' tunga nong guat minpha mah amaute ka guan khinzo hi.
Kei nong sawl lam leh kei nong it bang lianin amaute zong na it lam leitung in a theih nadingin amau' sungah kei omin kei' sungah nang na omna tawh amaute pumkhat bit hisak in.
Pa aw, leitung a kilamkip ma-in kei nong it a, tua hanga nong guat ahi keima' minpha pen kei nong piak mite in zong a muh nadingin amaute keima' omna ah a om theih ding uh ka lunggulh hi.
A thutang ka Pa aw, leitung in nang hong theih keileh zong ke'n nang kong thei a, hih mite in zong kei nong sawl lam thei uh hi.
Amaute' sungah kei' tunga nong neih nong itna mah a om theih nading leh kei zong ka om theih nadingin amaute' kiangah nangma' min ka theisak khinzo a, zong ka theisak zomlai ding hi.”
